title: A lane session opens its PR as a draft: the guard refuses a ready PR from mcp__github__create_pull_request or `gh pr create`
why: Coordinator 13:58 CST Nov 8: #2251 opened ready at 13:42 CST because lane handoff-keeps-owner-waits passed no draft field to mcp__github__create_pull_request. Its CI run then blocked batch 65's merge at 13:56 CST. Fix: refuse create_pull_request, and `gh pr create`, from a cs-build:lane session unless draft is true. The draft-PR guard steps (draft-pr-guard-heredoc, draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm) touch the same guard; check whether it already reads the MCP tool.
note: Coordinator 14:51 CST Nov 8: #2284 (head 4b3efbf42) with runner 8 after rounds 1-3 plus a fix check, lint at head. Cause: the draft guard existed, but the settings.json matcher never listed create_pull_request. Debt from its own lane (#2284, via the coordinator 16:22 CST Nov 8): a `gh api` POST, or update_pull_request with draft:false, can still mark a PR ready, which goes around the draft rule. It is in the triage outbox for the debt store. Doing 05:58 CST Nov 10: open PR #2284 on branch lane-pr-opens-as-draft (triage live build). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL1TctxZavHdqbiX2y7.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10). Folded 13:49 CST Nov 12 into the auto-merge-refused lane (same matcher). Incident 14:42 CST Nov 12 (coordinator): lane mutate-guard-split marked its own #2916 ready (ae39171901); its run blocked green batch 104 (#2814) from merging (no-merge-during-batch-ci refused). Coordinator told the lane to re-draft and cancel, runner 10 as fallback, and now adds "only the batch runner marks ready" to every brief. Kin to cover here: the guard also refuses a lane marking its own PR ready (update_pull_request draft=false, gh pr ready), not only a PR opened ready. Incident 00:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 00:58, from runner 12; unchecked by triage): mailaudit lane ci-fixes-mailaudit marked its own PR #328 ready, against the standing Lane draft PR grant (a lane never marks ready); ruling own-820-c-five-repos does not grant it. This is the gap the Nov 8 debt already named: this step's guard covers opening a ready PR, not marking one ready later (a `gh api` call, update_pull_request with draft:false, or `gh pr ready`). Which call the lane used is unread. Step lane-push-ready-pr-refuse (todo) is the push-side twin. Neighbour 01:54 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 01:53, relayed): owner ruling own-ready-by-priority (01:52 and 01:53 CST): a batch runner marks handed-in PRs ready by priority and by live CI queue state (no fixed slot number), not at once. The grant "Lane draft PR" stands: only the batch runner marks ready. A lane that marks its own PR ready (mailaudit #328) breaks both.
